title: Roll20 API Error Burst Watch
dataSources: Character sheets (`rpg:character`), VTT sessions (`rpg:session`), initiative rounds (`rpg:initiative`), encounters (`rpg:combat`), campaign ops (`rpg:ops`).
app: Tabletop campaign telemetry — D&D Beyond character exports, Roll20 session logs, initiative trackers, and campaign asset checklists — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rpg:session campaign=* api_error_burst=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(api_error_burst="yes",1,0))) as matched by campaign
| eval an_api_error_burst_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - an_api_error_burst_pct
description: Measures the percentage of Roll20 sessions that end with an API error burst by campaign.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which campaign are helping or hurting Roll20 sessions.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `an API error burst` on `rpg:session` events and summarize the hit rate by `campaign`.
visualization: Table of campaign with percentage of Roll20 sessions ending with an API error burst.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how often an API error burst happens for each campaign so you can see where Roll20 sessions go smoothly or get stuck.
